narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On April 30, 2024, at approximately 1145 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a car wash in Taylor, Michigan, during a follow-up on an employer referral. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico without documents.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he crossed the border on foot near Eagle Pass, Texas, on 10/11/2020, the first and only time he has come to the United States.
OTHER INFORMATION:
The subject stated that his cousin was deported to Mexico in 2018 and now lives in Monterrey. The subject has never been arrested.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
